chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: When the Kharijites were killed, it was said to him: O Commander of the Faithful,

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title for Imam Ali.
key_terms.الْخَوَارِجُ: The Kharijites, a early Islamic sect known for their rebellion against Ali.

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say when told the Kharijites were killed?
ai.summary: This narration captures the pivotal moment following the Battle of Nahrawan, where Imam Ali (AS) responded to the news of the Kharijites' total annihilation with characteristic humility and detachment from worldly triumph. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Imam's balanced leadership, distinguishing between the political necessity of defeating rebels and the spiritual humility of a leader who does not boast over his enemies. The brevity of the report highlights the gravity of the event, serving as a lesson in how to handle victory without arrogance.
